meta.project: Flow Behavior and Thermal Effects in Multiphysics Systems
meta.status: RE-ANALYSIS - original project data was lost. No value here is an original internship value.
meta.note_on_class_A: NO parameter in this project is class A. The original files were lost and a filesystem sweep on 2026-09-18 confirmed no surviving artefact. Class A is retained in the schema only to make its absence explicit.

Di.name: Inner (bore) diameter
Di.note: Selected to give Re=30000 at low-subsonic air velocity

Do.name: Outer diameter
Do.note: Do/Di = 2 exactly so ln(Do/Di)=ln2; clean thick-cylinder validation

L.name: Heated length
L.note: L/D = 30; entry length is 18 D, leaving ~12 D developed

T_in.name: Inlet air temperature
T_in.note: Standard ambient; also the stress-free reference temperature

p_op.name: Operating (absolute) pressure
p_op.note: Outlet is 0 Pa GAUGE, i.e. p_op absolute

qpp_o.name: Heat flux on outer surface
qpp_o.note: Re-selected from 12000 after the correlation-validity check; keeps both load cases elastic

nu_s.name: Poisson's ratio, Inconel 718
nu_s.note: AUDIT: neither fetched datasheet listed it. Upper end taken (conservative for LC1). 1.4% spread.

rho_s.name: Density, Inconel 718
rho_s.note: 0.9% source spread. Does not enter any steady-state result.

n_corr.name: Property-variation exponent
n_corr.note: Literature range 0.4-0.575; sensitivity is computed and plotted

K_in.name: Sharp-edged entrance loss K
K_in.note: NOT present in the CFD domain - reported separately for a real installation

K_out.name: Sudden-expansion exit loss K
K_out.note: NOT present in the CFD domain - reported separately for a real installation

K_dev.name: Incremental entry-region dp
K_dev.note: IS present in the CFD domain (developing flow)

air_primary.source: Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Table A.4 (air, 1 atm). FROZEN in Section 1.
air_primary.density_note: Density is NOT taken from the table. It is computed as p_op/(R*T) at the stated operating pressure, because textbook air tables tabulate density at 100 kPa, not 101.325 kPa.

air_crosscheck.source: Cengel, Table A-15, Properties of air at 1 atm (verified 2026-09-18 via me.psu.edu hosted copy)

solid_props.source_thermal_mech: VDM Metals, VDM Alloy 718 Material Data Sheet No. 4127 (verified 2026-09-18)
solid_props.source_cte: High Temp Metals / Special Metals Inconel 718 tech data - mean CTE from 21 C, dual units given (verified 2026-09-18)
solid_props.cte_note: Mean CTE referenced from 21 C. Our reference is 27 C; the 6 K datum offset changes total thermal strain by 0.15% and is neglected.
